name: PowerShell — Script Execution Followed by Outbound Network Connection
description: EQL sequence rule correlating a suspicious PowerShell script block execution event with an outbound network connection from the same host within 30 seconds. This pattern is characteristic of reverse shell establishment: the attacker executes a TCPClient or similar payload in PowerShell, which immediately initiates an outbound connection to their listener. Detects the causal relationship between script execution and network activity rather than relying solely on keyword matching.
query:
sequence by host.name with maxspan=30s
  [ process where process.name == "powershell.exe" and event.code == "4104" and
    (powershell.file.script_block_text like~ "*TCPClient*" or
     powershell.file.script_block_text like~ "*DownloadString*" or
     powershell.file.script_block_text like~ "*Invoke-Expression*") ]
  [ network where process.name == "powershell.exe" and
    network.direction == "outbound" ]
author: Noel Biju John
